svg.text: Baseline sends only normal transactions; the attack run injects a two-block Deter-Z2 burst while normal traffic continues.
Included counts are corrected from chain tx hashes when RPC is available; txpool gas is a weighted estimate from observed txpool counts.
Block inclusion during the phased workload
Txpool gas pressure after each observed block
pool gas pressure jumps and remains elevated
First-0 optimization check: 125 included attack txs used 0-byte payload across 125 senders.
Final attack-run txpool gas estimate: pending 4,437 M gas + queued 0 M gas.
